summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Alison Platt as an Independent non-executive Director effective 1 October 2026, with membership on the Group Remuneration, Group Risk and Nomination and Corporate Governance Committees. She succeeds Dame Carolyn Fairbairn as Chair of the Group Remuneration Committee on 24 February 2027, subject to regulatory approval and following the 23 February 2027 Annual Results. Her annual fees total GBP 271,150, rising by GBP 150,000 as committee chair. No transaction or special situation is present.
